notice: Proposed defaults are not approval. Only the actual human owner may confirm a resolution and its approval reference.

owner_as_invitee.proposed_default: Owner participates but is never a follow-up recipient.

omitted_lists.proposed_default: Both availability lists absent/null succeed as a no-op without changing the answer; this does not reinterpret a supplied legacy replacement list.

text_write_concurrency.proposed_default: New range writes use read-plus-target-CAS even without a caller fingerprint; honor an explicit fingerprint. Legacy arrays retain unconditional compatibility only if owner confirms that risk.

write_lifecycle.proposed_default: Explicitly decide whether to preserve existing archived/finalized write behavior or lock writes; no unapproved change.

weekly_shorthand_clock.proposed_default: Weekly shorthand uses reference UTC; timezone is display-only.
